chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: Chapter 111 - The Matrons of the Mo Estate
chapter_meta_description: Han Li faces a tribunal of formidable wives at the Mo Estate. In a world of dangerous women and deadly secrets, his cool composure is his only weapon.
og_description: Han Li faces his first major social trial as he enters the dangerous world of mortal Jianghu politics.
twitter_description: The matrons gather. Han Li must navigate a war of words and wits, not blades.
